run_parse_pdf_url_cli: run the parse_pdf_url CLI to download a PDF from a URL and print its extracted text
create_download_pdf: create a function to download a PDF file from a URL and save it to disk
build_load_pdf: build a function to extract text from a PDF using pymupdf4llm with pymupdf and pypdf fallbacks
refactor_load_pdf_num_pages: refactor load_pdf to extract text from only the first N pages of a PDF
review_load_pdf_min_size: review load_pdf to enforce a minimum extracted text length threshold before returning results
